name: What preparation is needed before installing new bathroom trim?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before installing new bathroom trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before new bathroom trim can be installed, the walls should be fully prepped, meaning they are clean, dry, and painted. Any old trim or caulk should be removed, and the surfaces should be smooth and free of debris. Ensure the flooring is already in place. If replacing old trim, make sure the surface beneath is sound and free of damage. Proper preparation ensures that the new trim sits flush against the walls and floor, creating a professional and long-lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installing new bathroom trim, ensure walls are clean, dry, painted, and free of old trim/caulk, and flooring is already installed.
